---
applyTo: "**/*.py"
---

# Python Project Instructions

- Prefer clear, idiomatic Python.
- Add type hints where useful.
- Avoid overly broad `except:`; catch specific exceptions when possible.
- Avoid hardcoded local machine paths.
- Never log secrets (tokens, credentials, subscription URLs with tokens, private keys).
- Update or add tests when behavior changes.
- Run compile/tests as part of verification.
